age.evidence: A total of 34 retrospectively collected, untreated primary breast tumor specimens from young women (<40), with an equal number of tumors from older women (≥60), matched by race and IHC subtypes (based on ER, PR, HER2, Ki67), were selected for study from the CBCP.

material_type.evidence: Tumor breast cancer tissue samples were harvested by LMD into 20 µL of 100 mM TEAB/10% acetonitrile, pH 8.0 in MicroTubes (Pressure BioSciences, Inc) and were lysed and digested with a heat-stable form of trypsin (SMART Trypsin, ThermoFisher Scientific, Inc.) employing pressure cycling technology with a barocycler (2320EXT Pressure BioSciences, Inc).

sample_source.evidence: A total of 34 retrospectively collected, untreated primary breast tumor specimens from young women (<40), with an equal number of tumors from older women (≥60), matched by race and IHC subtypes (based on ER, PR, HER2, Ki67), were selected for study from the CBCP.

sex.evidence: Female participants who had both a source for germline DNA and OCT-embedded (Optimal Cutting Temperature compound) invasive breast tumor specimens available for molecular analyses were selected.
